_comment: npm audit advisories accepted with a reason and an expiry (scripts/audit-gate.mjs). An entry past its expiry fails CI again, so every exception is re-decided.

1108110.reason: Only reachable when PARSING an untrusted workbook. TCI uses xlsx solely to WRITE exports (src/lib/exportTable.ts: table_to_book + writeFile); no spreadsheet is ever read. The fixed SheetJS 0.20.x is not published on npm - it must be installed from cdn.sheetjs.com, which is the planned replacement.

1108111.reason: Regular-expression DoS in the PARSER on attacker-supplied cell content. TCI never parses a workbook (write-only use in src/lib/exportTable.ts). Same replacement plan as 1108110.
